findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: REPEAT X2 Inspector observed a used knife stored in the handwashing sink by the register. There were also a multi surface cleaner, and other cleaning supplies cluttering the sink surroundings. Discussed with PIC and the items were removed. Ensure that hand sinks are free and accessible at all times for handwashing. Handwashing sinks should not be use for storage or any other purpose other than their designated purpose.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: REPEAT Inspector observed there to be no hand soap available at the handwashing sink in the back by coffee station and no paper towels at the hand sink in the back by the triple sink. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC refilled the soap dispenser and provided the paper towels for the hand sinks. Ensure that there is hand soap and paper towels are available at all hand sinks to enable proper handwashing at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: REPEAT Inspector observed the soda nozzles  to be soiled. The PIC was made aware. The nozzles were removed, cleaned, and sanitized Ensure that food-contact surfaces such as the soda nozzles are monitored  and cleaned at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Ten bags of Doritos were that have exceeded the expiration date were observed on the shelves. Education was provided, the bags were removed and discarded. Ensure that the date of prep packaged food items are monitored at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.comment:

Ensure that the hand sink is accessible at all times and not used for any other purpose besides hand washing. 
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The bottom of the double door freezers in the store room are observed with an accumulation of food debris. These freezers need to be cleaned to remove the current build-up of food accumulation and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: It is observed that there is syrup spilt under each of the soda syrup stands. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned each time a spill couriers and at a frequency necessary to maintain these areas clean.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: It is observed that in the store room extra cleaning is necessary as hard to reach areas, such as under shel;vets, has an accumulation of soil/debris. Ensure these areas receive a detailed cleaning and then are cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soil/debris.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking of the men’s restroom sink is in a state of disrepair. Ensure the current caulking is removed and a fresh seal is placed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: Mop was observed to be stored inside the basin of the mop bucket with soiled water present. Ensure the mop is placed either in the top of the mop bucket or hung up on the wall to ensure proper air drying is accomplished.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: No proof of certified food manager certification. Provide proof of certified food protection manager supervision during each shift. Manager and another employee will be scheduled to take this course.
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of candy stored on the floor in the back storeroom. Store candy and food at least 6" off the floor. 

Observed cases of water stored outside the front of the building. Water must be stored so that it is protected from contact with direct sunlight.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11  (C) Food shall be protected by contamination by storing it: 1) in a clean, dry location; 2) where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination; 3) at least 6 inches above the floor. Reference 3-305.11.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment: It appears as though the hand washing sink in the front near the cappuccino machines may be leaking into a container in the cabinet below. Repair plumbing and clean out this cabinet.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15  (C) Repair plumbing according to Illinois and local plumbing code.  Reference 5-205.15.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
No sanitizer is available for the three compartment sink for wash, rinse, sanitize of tongs and donut cases. There is one spray bottle under the hand sink in the self service area with sanitizer and multiple rags that appear to have already been used under here as well. Provide sanitizer for the three compartment sink. When using sanitizer in a spray bottle, paper towels must be used and discarded after use. Sanitizer will br brought over from another store.
750-800b To prevent cross-contamination, kitchenware and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any interruption of operations during which time contamination may have occurred.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.comment:

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

Observed coffee filters stored on top of the coffee dispensers with no protection. Store coffee filters in a covered container.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Multiple items in open faced cooler were discarded due to temperatures ranging from 40F-53F. Manager called to have cooler serviced immediately. Food holding temperatures of 41F or below were moved to the walk in cooler. Cooler will not be used until it can hold a temperature of 41F or below in all areas of cooler. An order of destruction was completed regarding all foods out of temperature. 
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Chicken biscuit sandwich was probed on hot holding unit at 10:50AM at 112F. Employee stated they used time as a control and food should have been discarded by 10AM. Food was immediately discarded to CORRECT the violation.
750-150(b)  Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135°F or above except during the cooling process. Store hot foods at 135°F or above. (Except for rare roast beef which may be held at 130F.)

findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Pizza, sandwiches, fruit cups, etc in the open reach-in cooler were 46-50 degrees.  The food was discarded to CORRECT the violation.  (NOTE: Manager Jack Wolford stated that he did not need a Voluntary Destruction Agreement to be filled out.)

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
The open reach-in cooler was keeping potentially hazardous food (see #3a above) at 46-50 degrees.   Repair the cooler so it will keep food at 41 degrees or less.

750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:

750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.comment:

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

2.  The mop sink was soiled.
Clean the organizers and mop sink.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(1) The coving below the filter system in the back room to the right of the mop sink was pulled away from the wall in one spot. (REPEAT VIOLATION)
(2) The floor in the back supply room had cracks in it.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
(3) The floor under the supply room freezer was soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
(4) The floor along the wall under the syrup boxes to the left of the walk-in cooler door was soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
(5) A few tiles were loose at the threshold to the back supply room
Clean all floors.  Re-attach the coving to the wall.  Fill the cracks in the floor of the supply room.  Re-glue the loose floor tiles

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
